messages:
maria: Seeing a spike in APAC ingress failures -> lots of mTLS handshakes timing out (504s). Started around 09:12 UTC after the RBAC rollout to the KMS unwrap role. Logs show long HSM unwrap latency. Anyone else?
kevin: yup that's my rollout, rolled a tighter IAM policy for kms-unwrap-role at 09:05. I didn't expect latency effects but fwiw policy change only touched role binding.
sam: what do the proxy logs say? can you paste the TLS error lines?
maria: paste from edge-proxy: 
```
2026-03-23T09:11:58Z proxy-1 tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z kms-client unwrap start request_id=abc123 target=hsm-01
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z kms-client unwrap done request_id=abc123 duration_ms=612
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z proxy-1 tls: handshake timeout (HSM unwrap took 612ms)
```
kevin: HSM latency >600ms is high but HSM queueing was normal earlier. Could RBAC cause extra auth checks that delay unwrap calls?
olivia: audit-bot shows a spike in IAM denies at 09:06 for service account `edge-proxy@apac`. Denies were for `kms:Decrypt` on a subset of requests.
audit-bot: ALERT: 43 denied KMS:Decrypt requests in apac/edge pool between 09:06-09:13. Sample principal: svc-edge-proxy@apac. Policy change id: iam-rollout-2026-03-23.
sam: ok that matches. If the client is getting transient denies, it may retry and queue leading to higher apparent unwrap latency. We should check the KMS metrics for auth failures and retries.
maria: mitigation idea: revert the binding for edge-proxy to previous role and let it fallback to cached keys. Can someone approve rollback? This is affecting latency SLOs.
kevin: I can rollback 2 patches ago (pre-rollout) across APAC now. Will push in 2 min.
olivia: before rollback, add a short-lived audit marker so we can correlate. I propose we tag requests from the rollback window with `incident-3251234567`. ops/sre can pick that up in logs.
audit-bot: ACTION_LOG: created incident ticket INC-2026-3251234567 and added audit markers for subsequent unwrap requests.
maria: rolling back now would help, but we also need a follow-up: add a software unwrap fallback in the rotator when HSM auth fails or is denied, plus alerting on KMS deny rate >5/min.
sam: agree. I'll open a PR for fallback logic (rotator: try HSM then software-unwrap-if-denied). Also adding a circuit-breaker so unwrap latency >250ms triggers cached key path.
kevin: rollback deployed to apac-edge. Early signs: unwrap deny count dropping.
maria: seeing 504s falling back to normal. Thanks. Postmortem items: add RBAC rollout checklist to include perf baseline, add audit-enrichment to unwrap logs, create runbook step: quick-role-rollback.
olivia: I'll own the runbook edits and the audit log enrichment.
audit-bot: NOTE: incident closed to watchlist. Recommend post-incident review in eng-security channel tomorrow.
maria: tagging @oncall and filing follow-up ticket with link to PRs and test plan. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
